# darwin

Option values are nix-darwin's: see the [nix-darwin options](https://nix-darwin.github.io/nix-darwin/manual/). Usage: [Linux and macOS helpers](../reference/nix.md).

## darwin()

Any nix-darwin options, as an object.

```ts
darwin(config: DarwinOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## darwin.imports()

Import nix-darwin modules (`inputs.x.darwinModules.y`, or module paths).

```ts
darwin.imports(imports: string[]): Fragment
darwin.imports(...imports: string[]): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## darwin.program()

Enable a nix-darwin program, with its options: `programs.<name>` with `enable = true`.

```ts
darwin.program(name: string, opts?: ProgramOptions<DarwinProgramOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## darwin.service()

Enable a nix-darwin service, with its options: `services.<name>` with `enable = true`.

```ts
darwin.service(name: string, opts?: ServiceOptions<DarwinServiceOptions, K>): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## darwin.homebrew()

Homebrew (`homebrew`): casks, brews and Mac App Store apps.

```ts
darwin.homebrew({ enable: true, casks: ["visual-studio-code"] });
```

```ts
darwin.homebrew(config: HomebrewOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

## darwin.launchd()

launchd agents and daemons.

```ts
darwin.launchd(config: LaunchdOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

### darwin.launchd.agent()

A per-user agent (`launchd.user.agents.<name>`).

```ts
darwin.launchd.agent("emacs", { serviceConfig: { ProgramArguments: ["emacs", "--fg-daemon"] } });
```

```ts
darwin.launchd.agent(name: string, config: LaunchdAgentOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.

### darwin.launchd.daemon()

A system daemon (`launchd.daemons.<name>`).

```ts
darwin.launchd.daemon(name: string, config: LaunchdAgentOptions): Fragment
```

Returns a fragment: declared when called through a feature's or host's namespace, otherwise return it.
